title: myrheim-meyer-dimension
description: A real-valued geometric invariant of a Lorentzian causal settling, computed by inverting the Myrheim-Meyer function on the ordering fraction (causally-related pairs over total pairs); the discrete causal-set analog of a Lorentzian manifold's topological dimension.

settling.description: the Lorentzian causal settling v on a finite causal set (E, <=) whose dimension is measured

orderingFraction.description: r(v) = 2|Apex_v| / (N(N-1)): strictly-ordered pairs over total pairs, the combinatorial input

value.description: d_MM(v) = f^{-1}(r(v)), the Myrheim-Meyer dimension; f^{-1} inverts f(d) = Gamma(d+1) Gamma(d/2) / (4 Gamma(3d/2)), single-valued on r in (0, 3/4)

calibration.description: calibrated against d-dimensional Minkowski space: f(1) = 1/2, f(2) = 1/4, f(4) = 0.05, f(d) -> 0 as d -> infinity, f(d) -> 3/4 as d -> 0+

coordinateFree.description: computable purely from the combinatorial causal order, with no reference to coordinates or a metric
